<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex47012026-03-2311-44-08" status="unreviewed">dang po ni <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo</rs></note> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">kha 1</rs> na re phyogs chos khyab pa dang rtags kyi tha snyad kyi spyi 'brel gtan la 'bebs pa la gtan tshigs kyi mtshad gtan la 'bebs pa'i skabs zhes gsung | 'di ma rigs te skabs kyi grangs nges mi 'thad pa dang btags pa'i
               <lb n="40a4"/>dgos pa mi 'grub pa'i phyir | ji ltar na rtags kyi mtshan nyid gtan la 'bebs pa'i skabs dang phyogs chos kyi <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> dang | khyab pa'i mtshan nyid dang sgrub bya'i mtshan nyid gtan la 'bebs pa'i skabs te bzhi byung pas skabs 3 gyi grangs nges nyamso |</seg></TEI>
